info.name: HR Endpoints
info.description:
# HR Management API Collection

This collection provides comprehensive access to the HR Management System API.

## Quick Start

1. **Login**: Use the `User - Done > Login` endpoint to authenticate
2. **Set Token**: The access token will be automatically saved to `{{access_token}}`
3. **Use Endpoints**: All authenticated endpoints use the Bearer token automatically

## Features

- **User Management**: Authentication, settings, notifications
- **Common Data**: Departments, employees, leave types, projects, and more
- **Leave Management**: Request and approve leaves
- **HR Workflows**: Various HR request types
- **Project Management**: Track projects and tasks
- **Help Desk**: Support ticket system

## Authentication

All endpoints (except login) require Bearer token authentication:
```
Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}
```

## Base URL

Set the `local_v1` variable to your API base URL:
- Development: `http://localhost:8000/api/v1`
- Production: `https://api.yourcompany.com/api/v1`

## Documentation

For complete API documentation, see: API_Documentation.md
